sentences.en: It is hard for an empty sack to stand straight.
The official got the sack for currying favor with the contractors.
sentences.zh: 那位官员因向承包商行贿而被解雇。

sentences.en: They got the sack for being careless and tardy.
sentences.zh: 他们因为粗心大意和迟到而被解雇。
